0022600135.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-2, 0-1 at home) host the Philadelphia 76ers (3-1), who sit first in the Atlantic and second in the East, while Indiana is third in the Central, 1.5 games back, and eighth in the East. Both teams lost their most recent game, and the teams have not yet met in 2026-27, after Philadelphia won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026. For Indiana, Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) are out, while Andrew Nembhard (back soreness) and Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. For Philadelphia, Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain) are out, while Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Joel Embiid (heel) and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen bruise) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
